narrative:
Ashtabula County has 58,992 registered voters, with 57.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 22.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 20.3%, a narrow Republican lean of 1.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 32.2% of registrants.
